clue.text: Hot city in Asia? Bad bad bad!

indicators.note: the last 'bad' says the letters before it are spoilt and must be reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: A traveller exclaims in disgust about a sweltering Asian city.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits the city is not in Asia at all: the letters of ASIA BAD BAD, shuffled as the final 'bad' signals, give the Ethiopian capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Addis Ababa is the capital of Ethiopia, a warm African country, so it is a city that can be called hot.

clue.text: Enthusiastic about return of opera singer

indicators.note: a return turns the singer's word so it runs back to front

parts.note: a diva is a leading female opera singer

explanation.surface: Someone keen to see a celebrated soprano come back to the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone eager and keen.

clue.text: This is no way to carry on as a motorist!

definitions.text: This is no way to carry on as a motorist!

parts.words: This is no way to carry on as a motorist!
parts.note: reads like a rebuke for bad driving, but literally describes a road with no way through, where a driver cannot carry on

explanation.surface: A scolding aimed at a reckless driver.
explanation.definitionFit: A road closed at one end gives a driver no route onward.

clue.text: Cook serves rice, etc, for spies

indicators.note: to cook figures or books is to doctor them, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Kitchen instructions oddly ending with a reference to espionage.
explanation.definitionFit: A government intelligence agency is staffed by spies.

clue.text: Suit barely worn?

parts.note: sounds like clothing with little use, but points to the idiom for nakedness, a suit worn by someone bare

explanation.surface: A nearly new outfit for sale.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'in one's birthday suit' means naked, as on the day of birth.

clue.text: Meat business enter embargo

indicators.note: the business's abbreviation must go into the word for embargo

parts.note: an embargo is a ban on trade
Co is the abbreviation for company, a business

explanation.surface: A meat firm breaks through a trade blockade.
explanation.definitionFit: Cured pork from the back or sides of a pig is a kind of meat.

clue.text: Charts rejected unwanted correspondence

indicators.note: something rejected is thrown back, so the word for charts is read backwards

parts.note: maps are charts

explanation.surface: Graphs sent unbidden are tossed aside as junk mail.
explanation.definitionFit: Junk email sent in bulk to unwilling recipients is unwanted correspondence.

clue.text: Dessert? It's normal to get fat eating one

parts.note: par is the normal or standard level

indicators.note: the word for fat consumes the numeral, which sits inside it

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A diner excuses gaining weight from sweets as perfectly normal.
explanation.definitionFit: A frozen layered sweet course is a type of dessert.

clue.text: Most realms have potential to be dangerous, currently

definitions.text: Most realms have potential to be dangerous, currently

indicators.note: the letters of the first two words could become something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: A gloomy prophecy that most kingdoms are now at risk.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of MOST REALMS rearrange into the answer, and the whole clue describes it: whirlpools are perilous because of their currents.
explanation.definitionFit: Violent whirlpools are dangerous in the currents of water they create.

clue.text: Is Bill after a man?

indicators.note: the word for bill follows the 'a'

parts.note: AC (account) is a bill

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether an invoice comes after one man.
explanation.definitionFit: Isaac is a man's name, as of the biblical patriarch.

clue.text: Does one career so around end of Cesarewitch?

definitions.text: Does one career so around end of Cesarewitch?

indicators.note: the letters are turned around and jumbled into another order
only the final letter of the race's name is taken

explanation.surface: A racegoer wonders which runner charges about near the end of a famous race.
explanation.walkthrough: The Cesarewitch is a long-distance flat horse race run at Newmarket in England, so the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A thoroughbred running in such a race careers around the course.

clue.text: Very large, drunk and initially arrogant

indicators.note: says the drunk word and 'and' come first, before the word for very large

parts.note: high is slang for drunk or intoxicated
mighty means very large or powerful

explanation.surface: A big, inebriated man who starts out haughty.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes someone overbearing and lordly.

clue.text: A panther's leg's damaged tall plant

indicators.note: damaged letters are broken up and reassembled in a new order

parts.note: taken with its S
taken with its S

explanation.surface: A big cat's injured limb.
explanation.definitionFit: This tropical grass grows taller than a person, high enough to hide large animals.

clue.text: Explorer, say, has room with art

parts.note: space is room
craft is skill or art

explanation.surface: An explorer has room for his artwork.
explanation.walkthrough: Explorer 1 was the first American satellite, so 'Explorer' is an example, not an adventurer.
explanation.definitionFit: An orbiting satellite is an example of a vehicle built for travel beyond Earth.

clue.text: Support Leeds and apt to be embarrassed

indicators.note: embarrassed letters are thrown into disorder and come out jumbled

explanation.surface: Fans back Leeds United even though they are liable to shame them.
explanation.walkthrough: Leeds is a city in northern England with a well-known football club.
explanation.definitionFit: A plinth or base for a statue is a support.

clue.text: Cricketer's clobber

explanation.surface: Some sportsman's kit.
explanation.walkthrough: Clobber is British slang for clothes, which the surface suggests; here it is the verb to hit.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a cricket player at the wicket; the other means to pound repeatedly.

clue.text: Islander makes preserve with tin holding a hint of it

indicators.note: the two words around it hold the letters between them

parts.note: jam is a fruit preserve
a can is a tin

indicators.note: only the first letter of 'it' is given

explanation.surface: A Caribbean native makes jam in a tin.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from Jamaica, a Caribbean island, is an islander.

clue.text: Yellow room in a hospital is after a short bed

indicators.note: the hospital room comes after the cut-down bed
short means the bed's word loses its final letter

parts.note: a cot is a bed
a ward is a room in a hospital

explanation.surface: A jaundiced patient lies on a short bed in a hospital room.
explanation.walkthrough: Yellow means cowardly, not the colour of a patient.
explanation.definitionFit: Yellow is slang for cowardly, so a yellow person is a craven one.

clue.text: Fly on end of a shoe

indicators.note: in a down entry, on means placed above, so this piece comes first

parts.note: to wing is to fly
a tip is an end

explanation.surface: An insect lands on the toe of a shoe.
explanation.definitionFit: A brogue style with a toe cap shaped like spread wings is a kind of shoe, mainly in American usage.

clue.text: Applaud a number featuring opium

indicators.note: the opening words feature the answer within them, running across the word breaks

explanation.surface: Praise for a song about a drug.
explanation.walkthrough: It looks like a charade of praise, A and a number, but the letters run unbroken through 'appLAUD A NUMber'.
explanation.definitionFit: This tincture is a preparation of opium dissolved in alcohol.

clue.text: Skittle Spooner's yearning for

indicators.note: Spooner was famous for swapping the opening sounds of neighbouring words, so the two pieces trade beginnings

parts.note: to pine is to yearn, so a yearning is a pine
in means for, as in being in favour of

explanation.surface: A skittle player confesses a longing.
explanation.walkthrough: Say 'pine in' as one run, 'pie-nin', then swap the P and N sounds to get 'nine-pin'. The swap works by sound, across the run of the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: Each of the nine pins knocked down in the old bowling game is a skittle.

clue.text: Kindness is a factor to be borne in mind

definitions.text: a factor to be borne in mind

explanation.surface: A thoughtful act noted as relevant.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is thoughtful regard for others; the other is any matter weighed when deciding.

clue.text: Chemical from exotic trees

indicators.note: exotic means foreign and strange, so the letters come out in an unfamiliar order

explanation.surface: A substance extracted from foreign woods.
explanation.definitionFit: A compound formed from an acid and an alcohol is a chemical.

clue.text: Going north, to the old island

indicators.note: in a down entry, going north means reading upwards, so the pieces run backwards

parts.note: taken as written
ye is an old form of 'the'

explanation.surface: Heading north towards an ancient island.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyot is a small river island, especially on the Thames.

clue.text: Real gold? Then it's back to castle, initially

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
taken as written

indicators.note: the pronoun is turned back to front

parts.note: the pronoun without its 's

indicators.note: takes only the first letter of castle

explanation.surface: Someone checks whether gold is genuine, then returns it to a castle.
explanation.definitionFit: Genuine and real both mean not fake.

clue.text: Dwarf is very quiet in the grass

indicators.note: the musical letters go inside the word for grass

parts.note: hay is dried grass
pp, pianissimo, is the musical direction for very quiet

explanation.surface: A small figure lies silent in the meadow.
explanation.walkthrough: Dwarf is the definition, an example: one of the seven dwarfs in the Snow White story.
explanation.definitionFit: He is one of the seven dwarfs in the fairy tale of Snow White.

clue.text: Record backs some telepathy

indicators.note: the part runs backwards, right to left
some says only a part of the word is used

explanation.surface: A recording supports a claim of mind-reading.
explanation.definitionFit: To record sound or video was to put it on magnetic tape.

clue.text: Unstable type of reef?

parts.note: sounds like a coral formation that could collapse, but a reef is also a sailor's knot, and this variant tied wrongly slips

explanation.surface: A coral reef liable to collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: This knot is a reef knot tied wrongly, which slips under load.
